items.title: Zero format loss
items.description: Editing an existing workbook preserves pivot tables, VBA macros, charts, sparklines, conditional formatting and named ranges.

items.title: CJK first-class
items.description: Handles Chinese sheet names and headers, GB18030/GBK encodings, full-width characters, and Chinese number and date conventions.

items.title: Create and analyze
items.description: Builds workbooks from scratch or reads and analyzes existing files, including formula recalculation and validation.

items.title: Verified output
items.description: Renders and checks the result before delivering, so formula and layout errors do not reach you.

items.title: Describe the spreadsheet you want
items.description: For example: summarize this sales data by quarter and build a pivot table.

items.title: The agent writes the file directly
items.description: No sub-agents are spawned; the .xlsx or .csv file is produced in place.

items.title: Self-check before delivery
items.description: Formulas and formatting are validated before the result is returned.

blocks.title: Supported formats
blocks.content: .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv and .tsv. Existing files are written back in their original format without downgrade saves.

## When to use

Reports, dashboards, budgets, financial models, pivot tables, and any task that produces or reads tabular data. Finance-specific conventions are isolated in their own section and do not affect general use.
